notes.title: Patch Notes | v0.1.3
notes.notes:
Hello Alchemists!

We continue our efforts to further improve our game and provide a more enjoyable experience for you. We are happy to share with you the improvements and fixes we have made in this update:

Fixed:
[list]
[*] You can now use the water well card with all apprentice cards.
[*] We have made some mission messages clearer.
[*] We show the money you earn from your sale to the customer more clearly.
[*] Minor fixes to the UI.
[*] Added the ability to close and open the information panel.
[*] Mouse sensitivity in the chest has been increased.
[*] You can see the properties of objects in the chest without removing them from the chest, just hover over them.
[*] Minor bugs have been fixed.
[/list]
Share Your Suggestions:

We want to improve the game even more with your feedback. We are waiting for your suggestions both in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2487110/discussions/]Steam[/url] discussion section and on our [url=https://discord.gg/4eNA6UF8Xx]Discord[/url] channel.

We continue our efforts to address any remaining issues. Stay tuned for updates!

Thank you,
[b]Kajoo Games[/b]

notes.title: The Early Access release of Alchemy Deck is finally here!
notes.notes:
The long-awaited moment has arrived! Alchemy Deck has been released in Early Access! We've come a long way since releasing our demo, thanks to your feedback, and we're very happy to be back with our Early Access release.

In this exciting game where you bring an alchemist to life, make and sell potions, destroy threats, and work your hardest to obtain the Philosopher's Stone, the only cure for immortality! To do this, make more potions, read books and improve your skills! It is also very important for an alchemist to master his workshop. These are absolutely necessary to be a good alchemist. Bandits? No one can deal with them but you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44471438/84e46e18d1e1e6568f00d8ed05f746ea712b02f9.png[/img]

We will be in direct dialogue with the community during Early Access. We will continue to listen to your feedback and suggestions. The game will be constantly updated to add more content and bug fixes. We'll share all updates on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2487110]Steam Community[/url] and the [url=https://discord.com/invite/4eNA6UF8Xx]Alchemy Deck Discord[/url].

We hope you enjoy Alchemy Deck. Have fun!

[b]KAJOO Games[/b]

notes.title: Alchemy Deck Demo Live Now
notes.notes:
It is with great joy that we announce that the [b]Alchemy Deck Demo[/b] is now available for download on Steam! We are excited to share with you the demo of the game we have been working on with dedication and passion. We plan to launch as early access in the first quarter of 2024. In the meantime, your feedback is extremely valuable to us. We want to hear your thoughts, suggestions and feedback on the game. This feedback will contribute significantly to the development of the game.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DNYjf_WQmDk

We also ask that you add the game to your [b]Steam wishlists[/b]. This shows how in-demand the game is, and we'll be even more motivated to see you join us on this magical adventure. If you want more interaction and conversation, you can join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/4eNA6UF8Xx]Discord[/url][/b] channel and contribute there.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2487110/Alchemy_Deck/

Please download and try out the Demo version on our Steam page and share your thoughts with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/4eNA6UF8Xx]Discord[/url] channel. What aspects you liked, where we can make improvements, we want to hear it all! By letting us know about any bugs or suggestions you see, you can help us make Alchemy Deck even better.

Thank you for joining us on this adventure and good luck on your journey of combining cards to make magical potions!

Until next time.
KAJOO Games
